title: Randomised clinical trial of skin closure techniques after median laparotomy in obese patients: Skin stapling or vertical mattress sutures?
summary: At the end of major belly surgery, the belly must be closed again. Skin closure can be achieved by using either surgical sutures or metallic staples. In this study, both techniques will be compared in order to find out which technique results in better wound healing. The study is restricted to adults who are overweight and undergo surgery via a midline incision.

interventions.name: Skin closure using vertical mattress sutures in Donati technique (Prolene® 2/0, Ethicon Inc, Germany) placed in 1 cm distance
Skin closure using skin staples (Manipler® AZ 35W, B. Braun Surgical S.A., Rubí, Spain) placed in 1 cm distance

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indication for elective surgery using median laparotomy
Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m2
Exclusion criteria:
Current chemotherapy
Current immunosuppressive therapy (e.g. systemic corticsteroids)
